newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TENNIS-CHESNOKOV TO MEET ONDRUSKA IN OPENING MATCH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CHESNOKOV TO MEET ONDRUSKA IN OPENING MATCH.

text.p: Russian number one Andrei Chesnokov will meet South African number two Marcos Ondruska in the opening singles of their Davis Cup world group, first-round tie on Friday.
In Thursday's draw world number eight Wayne Ferreira was paired with Andrei Cherkasov.
The Russian team is severely depleted after the withdrawal through injury of their top player Yevgeny Kafelnikov and the experienced Alexander Volkov.
But their doubles specialist Andrei Olhovsky believes that despite the heat and humidity Durban's slow-paced hardcourt could suit the Russians.

"I would much prefer to play the tie indoors -- it's more comfortable for the players and also for the spectators," Olhovsky said. "But the court here in Durban is very slow and it will not be easy to play against us under these conditions."
South Africa's non-playing team captain Danie Visser was cautiously optimistic.
"We should win this tie," he said. "But we know that Cherkasov, Chesnokov and Olhovsky can all play and we'll have to be on our best form to beat them."
Friday's opening singles: Marcos Ondruska (South Africa) vs Andrei Chesnokov (Russia), Wayne Ferreira (South Africa) vs Andrei Cherkasov (Russia)
Saturday's doubles: Ellis Ferreira and Grant Stafford (South Africa) vs Cherkasov and Andrei Olhovsky (Russia)
Sunday's reverse singles: Ferreira vs Chesnokov, Ondruska vs Cherkasov
